name: ExtensionEncounter_Reason_Value
title: R5: Reason the encounter takes place (core or reference) additional types
purpose:
This extension is part of the cross-version definitions generated to enable use of the
element `Encounter.reason.value` as defined in FHIR R5
in FHIR R4.

The source element is defined as:
`Encounter.reason.value` 0..* `CodeableReference(http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Condition,http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/DiagnosticReport,http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Observation,http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/ImmunizationRecommendation,http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Procedure)`

Across FHIR versions, the element set has been mapped as:
*  R5: `Encounter.reason.value` 0..* `CodeableReference(http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Condition,http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/DiagnosticReport,http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Observation,http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/ImmunizationRecommendation,http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Procedure)`
*  R4B: `Encounter.reasonCode` 0..* `CodeableConcept`
*  R4: `Encounter.reasonCode` 0..* `CodeableConcept`

Following are the generation technical comments:
Element `Encounter.reason.value` is mapped to FHIR R4 element `Encounter.reasonCode` as `SourceIsBroaderThanTarget`.
Element `Encounter.reason.value` is mapped to FHIR R4 element `Encounter.reasonReference` as `SourceIsBroaderThanTarget`.
The mappings for `Encounter.reason.value` do not cover the following types: CodeableReference.
